newsitem.title: MEXICO: Southern Mexico hit by Tropical Storm Blanca.
newsitem.headline: Southern Mexico hit by Tropical Storm Blanca.

text.p: Tropical Storm Blanca hit the Pacific coast of Mexico on Tuesday with raging winds, rain and choppy seas, forcing the closure of the ports of Acapulco and Zihuatenejo, television reports said.
TV Azteca, in its nightly news bulletin, said the storm hit hardest in the southern state of Guerrero, but heavy rains fell across other states in the south and southwest.
There were no reports of major damage or injuries.
